name: Prone Deficiency
description: If the creature is knocked prone, roll a die. On an odd result, the creature lands upside-down and is incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns, the creature can make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, righting itself and ending the incapacitated condition if it succeeds.
